mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT c.id AS couple_id, c.groom_id AS groom_id, c.bride_id AS bride_id, me.id AS user_id, me.name AS user_name, me.role AS user_role, partner.id AS partner_user_id, partner.name AS partner_name, partner.role AS partner_role, c.status AS couple_status FROM couple c INNER JOIN `user` me ON me.id = #{userId} AND me.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN `user` partner ON partner.id = CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id WHEN c.bride_id = #{userId} THEN c.groom_id END AND partner.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE c.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND c.groom_id IS NOT NULL AND c.bride_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND ( NULLIF(TRIM(a.connected_id), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.account_id), '') IS NOT NULL ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.user_id = #{userId} AND ( NULLIF(TRIM(cd.connected_id), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(cd.card_id), '') IS NOT NULL ) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS account_linked, CASE WHEN main_goal.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS wedding_goal_created, CASE WHEN main_goal.id IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(main_goal.region), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS region_selected, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM service_record sr WHERE sr.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND sr.type = 'SAVING' AND sr.amount > 0 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS first_saving_recorded, main_goal.id AS main_goal_id, main_goal.status AS main_goal_status, DATE_FORMAT(main_goal.wedding_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS wedding_date, NULLIF(TRIM(main_goal.region), '') AS region FROM ( SELECT 1 AS checklist_base ) base LEFT JOIN goal main_goal ON main_goal.id = ( SELECT g.id FROM goal g WHERE g.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND g.is_main = TRUE AND g.status IN ('NORMAL', 'DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY CASE g.status WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, g.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
